exposure: breastfeeding initiation in the first hour of life
cohort: The study included 423 infants, 324 from a Baby-friendly Hospital and 99 from a non-BFH, along with their mothers from two hospitals in the Lisbon metropolitan area, Portugal.
finding: The exclusive breastfeeding rate was 74.2% at discharge, 51.8% at three months, and 25.6% at six months, with several socio-cultural and birth-related factors influencing its continuation or discontinuation.
birth_weight: Adequate birthweight was identified as a factor promoting exclusive breastfeeding.
gest_age: Older gestational age was identified as a factor promoting exclusive breastfeeding.
